description:
Copy test cases (`tcIds`) and/or reusable functions (`functionIds`) of the ACTIVE project into ANOTHER project — the SimplifyQA "Copy to project" popup. Use this, not `tc_clone` / `fn_clone`, when the user says "copy / move / duplicate to another project". `tc_clone` and `fn_clone` only copy inside one project.

Copies the chosen versions with steps, objects, parameters, nested functions and test data. A name that already exists in the destination project becomes `<name>_copy1`. The destination project needs the "copy test case across projects" / "copy function across projects" privilege for what is copied and, if the steps use custom step fields, the same fields.

TWO-STEP: call WITHOUT `confirm` to preview (destination project/module, versions, environments, name clashes), show it to the user, then call again with `confirm:true`. The backend copies in the background; the reply lists the copies it found in the destination and the ones still pending.

ASK THE USER, never assume: (1) which VERSION when an item has several — `versions` for all items or `versionsBy` per item (never default to the latest or v1; `["all"]` copies every version); (2) "Copy the test data too?" — `copyTestData:true|false` is REQUIRED to copy (false = only the empty ITR-1 structure, like `tdCopy:false` of tc_clone).

`destinationProject` is the project id, code or exact name; `destinationModule` is a module id or exact name in THAT project (default: its root module). `environments` are the environment NAMES whose test data is copied (default: every environment both projects have; names are matched exactly).

copyTestData.description: Copy the test data too? REQUIRED to copy — ask the user. false copies only the empty ITR-1 structure.

destinationModule.description: Module of the destination project (id or exact name). Default: its root module.

destinationProject.description: Destination project: id, code or exact name.

environments.description: Environment names whose test data is copied. Default: every environment both projects have. Not with copyTestData:false.

functionIds.description: Functions to copy, from the active project: numeric ids or FN-… codes.

tcIds.description: Test cases to copy, from the active project: numeric ids or TC-… codes.

versions.description: Version names to copy for every item (e.g. ["v1.0","v2.0"]; "v2" and "2" also match v2.0), or ["all"]. Required when an item has several versions — ask the user.

versionsBy.description: Versions per item, keyed by its code or id, e.g. {"TC-12826":["v1.0"],"TC-12827":["v2.0"]}. Beats `versions`.

name: tc_copy_to_project
title: Copy test cases / functions to another project
